race.comment: CAUTIONARY TAIL (3) looks worth sticking with after breaking through at the Gold Coast, his earlier Lismore third also had merit after he was held up on the turn. Can go on with it now. SHAME ON SUE (12) should be at her top now fourth-up after some strong finishing efforts. If they can utilise the low draw, she will have a major say in the finish. CLUBHOUSE (8) hasn't won for a long time but has been thereabouts of late. Backs up quickly and is worth keeping safe for a minor spot. SIR DON (5) has patchy form but boasts peaks that can measure up. Not dismissing completely.
